description: React component for the global data retention policy form in Mattermost admin console, allowing configuration of message and file retention settings.

classes.name: GlobalPolicyForm
classes.description: React component class for managing global data retention policies in the admin console.

methods.name: getDefaultInputValue
methods.description: Returns default input value based on whether retention is enabled and hours value.

methods.name: getDefaultDropdownValue
methods.description: Returns default dropdown selection based on retention hours.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, updates configuration, and navigates upon success.

methods.name: setDeletionEnabled
methods.description: Determines if deletion is enabled based on dropdown value.

methods.name: setRetentionHours
methods.description: Converts dropdown value and input into hours for retention setting.

methods.name: isMessageRetentionSetByEnv
methods.description: Checks if message retention is set by environment variables.

methods.name: isFileRetentionSetByEnv
methods.description: Checks if file retention is set by environment variables.
